message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

# ==========================================================================
# Fast Checks
# ==========================================================================

jobs:
  check:
    name: Format
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@v4
      - run: mise run restore
      - run: mise run check

  # ==========================================================================
  # Core Tests
  # ==========================================================================

  test:
    name: Test (${{ matrix.os }})
    needs: [check]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@v4
      - run: mise run restore
      - run: mise run build
      - run: mise run test

  # ==========================================================================
  # Build + Pack
  # ==========================================================================

  build:
    name: Build + Pack
    needs: [check]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@v4
      - run: mise run restore
      - run: mise run build
      - run: mise run pack

  # ==========================================================================
  # Final Gate
  # ==========================================================================

  ci-success:
    name: CI Success
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [check, test, build]
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Check all jobs passed
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ needs.check.result }}" != "success" ]] || \
             [[ "${{ needs.test.result }}" != "success" ]] || \
             [[ "${{ needs.build.result }}" != "success" ]]; then
            echo "One or more required jobs failed"
            exit 1
          fi",
  "rationale": "The test job runs a matrix across three operating systems and ci-success is an AND gate requiring test to succeed. Under P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (cancel remaining matrix jobs after failure), once any matrix cell fails the overall test job already fails and CI fails, so the remaining matrix cells are dispensable for the gate. Adding fail-fast: true cancels in-progress/queued matrix cells on a failure, saving VM time without changing the pass/fail outcome or coverage in the all-success case. The change is a single workflow key, adds no new actions, secrets, permissions, publishing/deployment steps, or new network access, and preserves all existing steps and required checks.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-FAIL-FAST"]
}
